pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Comprehension.

2. When practising Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Imitative speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.

3. When practising Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.

4. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

5. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Buch
   D. Wasser

6. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Good night
   D. Please

7. When practising Guided writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided writing.

8. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.

9. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
